Question
========
Which family of theories of justice sees inequality as unproblematic as long as it results from free choices and voluntary exchange?

Answerlist
----------
* Libertarian theories
* Liberal egalitarian theories
* Collectivist theories
* The capability approach

Solution
========
Libertarians such as Nozick and the Friedmans give heavy weight to freedom and private property and see market outcomes as just if exchanges are voluntary.

Answerlist

* True

* False
* False
